links.comparator_used: General Gemini AI without grounding (training knowledge alone), with human-written questions as a reference
links.outcome: Quality ratings of generated MCQs (accuracy, clarity, complexity, relevance) and respondent correct-answer rates
links.effect: General AI differed significantly from human-written questions on accuracy, clarity and complexity but not relevance. Grounded AI showed no significant difference from human-written questions on any of the 5 metrics. Respondents were significantly more likely to answer both general and grounded AI questions correctly than human-written ones. The abstract reports no direct grounded vs general AI test.
links.tradeoff: AI-generated questions were easier to answer correctly than human-written ones, so the authors say difficulty must be sufficiently high and questions should be edited by a human expert.
links.quote: No statistically significant differences were found between grounded AI and human-written questions on any of the 5 metrics.
